speaker: Doctor

text: RESULTS: Interictal spikes and sharp waves localized to the temporal lobes, more prominent on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: The EEG confirms right-sided temporal lobe abnormality, which aligns with the clinical presentation of auras and automatisms. DIAGNOSIS READY: Right Temporal Lobe Epilepsy
